Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the call this morning — quick follow-up on the invoicing side so our accounting team can prepare. We have two related points:

1) Invoice routing & PO mapping
   - You mentioned Redwood wants PO line-level mapping when one legal entity supplies both software (platform access) and implementation services. Can you confirm the PO layout and the subject line you prefer on the invoice email?

2) EU VAT / fiscal representative
   - Svenska Manufacturing AB is registered in SE (VAT SE123456789). For certain countries (e.g., where we have no local establishment) we sometimes use a fiscal representative. Do you accept invoices issued by our fiscal rep (tax representative) if the VAT certificate for that rep is provided? Any specific language you need on the invoice to trigger reverse-charge?

Attached are: sample-invoice-202611.pdf (example layout) and tax-rep-letter-request.docx (our rep info template).

Goal: we want to issue the first invoice in early December and need to link it to a PO and correct tax handling.

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear note and attachments. I've looped in Monica (procurement) and Lauren (finance) so we can get you a PO and confirm the accounting treatment. High-level answers below and a couple of asks so we can proceed: 

1) PO & invoice routing (what to put on the invoice email)
   - Send invoices to: invoices@redwood-invoice.com and please put the PO number in the subject (e.g., "PO 2026-RTL-00567 — Svenska Manufacturing AB"). CC procurement@redwood.com to expedite matching.
   - We will issue a single PO that contains two line items: SaaS subscription (service code 4401) and Professional services (service code 5403). When you create the invoice please break out the two lines exactly as on the PO and reference the PO line numbers on each invoice line. That allows our AP system to match automatically.

2) VAT / reverse charge / fiscal representative
   - Redwood's standard approach: if the supplier invoices from their EU legal entity (Svenska Manufacturing AB) using your SE VAT number, and the supply is B2B digital services, we typically apply reverse-charge (customer accounts for VAT) — you should include the buyer VAT (Redwood Inference EU VAT id: EU987654321) and the phrase "Reverse charge — Article 44(1) of Council Directive 2006/112/EC applies" on the invoice.
   - If you plan to invoice via a fiscal representative, we can accept that only if: (a) the invoice clearly shows the fiscal rep as the issuer and (b) you attach the fiscal representative agreement and the rep's local VAT registration certificate. We will need a copy of the rep's VAT registration and a short PDF confirming the representation (signed).

3) Documents we need before PO/first payment
   - Vendor tax form: please complete the attached "Redwood-EU-vendor-tax-form.pdf" (fields: legal name, legal entity ID, VAT number(s), registered address, bank details).
   - VAT certificate (official) for the invoicing entity or the fiscal representative.
   - If invoicing via rep: a signed tax-rep agreement (we can accept a scanned PDF).

4) Currency & remittance
   - We prefer EUR invoices for EU suppliers. Please also include IBAN + BIC. If you must invoice in SEK, let us know and we will confirm FX handling.

Next steps: Monica will raise a PO once we have the completed vendor tax form and VAT evidence. I have attached our PO routing instructions for your AP team.

Best,
